objective: Describe the terminal outcome the user actually wants.

requirements.text: A hard capability or behavior that must be present.

constraints.text: A platform, architecture, compatibility, cost, safety, or operational constraint.

invariants.text: A property that must remain true while implementation evolves.

nonGoals.text: A plausible interpretation that is explicitly outside the project.

decisions.text: A user-approved decision workers should not reopen without escalation.

preferences.text: A preference that may yield to hard requirements or constraints.

successDefinition: Describe the observable state in which the user would consider the project complete.
